'''Minder Fourteen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Minder (Imperial Intelligence)|Minder]] within [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], when [[Cipher Nine]] returned to the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]] after a lengthy undercover mission within the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], Minder Fourteen was assigned to debrief the [[Cipher Agent]]'s support crew.
